scope: Review of the next 15 alphabetically pending active catalog entries, Continue through DeepScribe. Fourteen accepted after first-party checks; Creatomate rejected because its official documentation establishes template-based media automation, not a native AI capability.

accepted.name: Continue
accepted.description: Open-source AI code assistant for VS Code, JetBrains and terminal workflows, with agent mode, chat, edit, inline autocomplete and custom agents/model providers.
accepted.userValue: For developers who want a model-flexible assistant integrated with their IDE and terminal, including agent actions and control over the models and tools they use.

accepted.name: Copy.ai
accepted.description: AI-native go-to-market platform connecting workflows, agents, reusable actions, company knowledge and GTM data for prospecting, account research, lead handling, content creation and account-based marketing.
accepted.userValue: For revenue teams that need repeatable, cross-functional AI workflows grounded in company data rather than isolated copy-generation prompts.

accepted.name: Corti
accepted.description: AI platform for critical industries with specialized models, clinical speech-to-text, medical coding, ambient documentation, agent orchestration and sovereign-cloud or on-prem deployments. Corti Assistant turns clinician-patient conversations into editable facts and EHR-ready notes.
accepted.userValue: For healthcare software teams and providers embedding domain-specific AI into clinical workflows; clinicians must review generated documentation and coding before use.

accepted.name: Crawl4AI
accepted.description: Open-source crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents; extracts clean Markdown or structured JSON, supports CSS/XPath and LLM-based extraction, browser control, MCP and a hosted API.
accepted.userValue: For developers building RAG, agent, search or data pipelines that need self-hosted, LLM-ready web content.

accepted.name: Creatify
accepted.description: AI ad-creation platform led by Ad Agent, which researches product URLs or uploaded assets, drafts ad concepts and scripts, generates short-form video ads and iterates edits through chat; includes URL-to-video and AI avatars.
accepted.userValue: For ecommerce and growth teams that need multiple UGC-style ad concepts and variations without manually filming and editing each creative.

accepted.name: Crisp AI
accepted.description: Crisp's integrated AI support suite, including Hugo AI Agent, knowledge-grounded answers, internal Hugo Copilot, smart replies, conversation summaries, content training and no-code workflows across messaging channels.
accepted.userValue: For support teams that want customer-facing automation plus agent assistance within their shared inbox, with configurable routing, integrations and human handoff.

accepted.name: CrowdStrike Charlotte AI
accepted.description: Agentic AI security analyst built into Falcon; supports natural-language investigation, cross-domain context, detection triage, query generation, custom security agents and governed response actions with analyst approvals.
accepted.userValue: For SOC teams managing high alert volume who need faster investigation and governed automation while retaining analyst control.

accepted.name: Curipod
accepted.description: AI lesson-creation and classroom-interaction platform for teachers; generates slides and activities, supports AI feedback on student writing and drawings, and lets teachers edit, run and translate lessons.
accepted.userValue: For teachers who want to prepare interactive lessons and give students timely feedback without building each slide and activity manually.

accepted.name: D-ID
accepted.description: AI video and agent platform that creates talking-avatar videos from text, images or audio, translates and lip-syncs videos, and deploys real-time conversational agents with LLMs and knowledge bases through APIs and SDKs.
accepted.userValue: For teams building digital presenters, localized video content or interactive avatar agents.

accepted.name: Dataiku
accepted.description: Enterprise AI platform combining data science, machine learning, analytics, agent creation, orchestration and governance; supports visual and code agents, model workflows, enterprise data connections and production oversight.
accepted.userValue: For enterprise data teams that need to build, deploy and govern analytics and AI systems across technical and business users.

accepted.name: Decktopus
accepted.description: AI presentation platform that turns a topic, notes or uploaded documents into a structured, branded deck, then supports AI editing, rehearsal feedback, sharing and viewer analytics.
accepted.userValue: For professionals and teams that need polished client, sales, educational or investor decks quickly, with editing and delivery tools in one workflow.

accepted.name: DeepEval
accepted.description: Open-source Python framework for testing LLM applications with 50+ metrics, LLM-as-judge, synthetic datasets and end-to-end, trajectory and component evaluation for agents, RAG, voice and multimodal workflows; optional Confident AI traces.
accepted.userValue: For engineering teams that need repeatable quality and safety checks for LLM features in pytest and CI/CD, with evaluations running locally.

accepted.name: DeepL Write
accepted.description: AI writing assistant that corrects grammar, spelling and punctuation and suggests clearer wording, alternative phrases, tone and style across web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions and productivity integrations.
accepted.userValue: For writers and teams polishing multilingual communications while preserving meaning and choosing a tone appropriate to the context.

accepted.name: DeepScribe
accepted.description: Ambient AI platform focused on oncology workflows, generating context-aware clinical notes from visits, preparing pre-chart summaries with SmartPrep and supporting diagnosis and coding intelligence inside oncology EHRs.
accepted.userValue: For oncology clinicians and health systems seeking to reduce documentation burden and keep visit context organized; clinicians must verify notes and coding before finalizing.

rejected.name: Creatomate
rejected.userValue: Creatomate automates video and image rendering from templates and API payloads; the official docs mention external AI-assistant integration and AI-powered workflows, but do not establish a built-in AI capability in the product itself.
rejected.reason: The official product documentation describes a template-driven media-rendering and automation API. Its AI references are to using an external AI assistant to configure or operate Creatomate, or to examples where other tools supply AI-generated content. The core product itself is not shown to provide an AI model or first-party AI function that materially performs the media creation. It is a useful video automation product, but it does not meet Creative AI's AI-tool inclusion standard.

notes: Creatify's current first-party help center identifies Ad Agent as its main ad-creation workflow and says it replaces Creative Agent; the entry is updated to current functionality rather than retaining retired subtool names.

Corti's current official site positions the company as an AI platform for critical industries, with specialized models, clinical speech, medical coding, agentic orchestration and sovereign infrastructure; clinical documentation outputs still require clinician review.

Crisp AI is retained as a first-party AI suite within Crisp. Hugo is the customer-facing AI agent within that suite, while Hugo Copilot assists human support operators; the catalog entry is not represented as an independent product.
CrowdStrike Charlotte AI is a first-party agentic analyst capability built into Falcon, with governed actions and analyst control; it is labeled as an integrated platform capability.

DeepScribe's current product is focused on oncology workflows; its description covers ambient notes, pre-chart summaries and coding support without implying autonomous diagnosis or replacing clinician judgment.
Creatomate remains excluded because its official docs describe a template-rendering automation product and external AI-assistant integration, not a native AI function in Creatomate itself.
